title: Reproducing LZ's 3.4 sigma local significance from the published summaries: a three-sample two-dimensional toy likelihood
question: Can Tables S6/S7 (3.4 sigma L10, 3.3 O1s delta=350, 0 O1s elastic, 2.7 O4) be reproduced without anchoring from Table I/S1/S2 counts and constraints, the Fig. 5 band-distance histograms, the tagging efficiencies and the toy-MC p0 definition, and which ingredient (2D PDFs, nuisances, veto samples, toy calibration) drives the residuals?
headline_result: An unanchored three-sample (S1c, d) likelihood reproduces 59 Table S6/S7 entries to rms 0.42 sigma (mean -0.22) and gives toy-calibrated 3.03 [2.98,3.10] sigma for L10 (3.22 with LZ's Fig. 1 spectrum) vs LZ's 3.4; O1s d350 2.98 (3.3), O4 2.55 (2.7), O1v 1.44 (1.3), O1s 0 (0); the 2D band variable carries the result (1D costs 0.6 sigma), nuisances 0.03 and veto samples 0.00 sigma; the residual 0.3 sigma sits in the unpublished S1c dependence of the 250-500 phd background (S1c>500 alone gives 3.5 sigma)
key_numbers: rms/mean vs S6/S7: NEST-only 0.68/-0.48, +Fig.5 d-shape 0.52/-0.28, +23 keV resolution 0.42/-0.22 sigma; toy Z L10 3.03 [2.98,3.10] (18559 toys), Fig.1-spectrum L10 3.22, O1s d350 2.98, O4s 2.55, O1v 1.44, O1s 0; 93559 toys; P(q0>0)=0.033 (L10) vs Chernoff 0.5, |Z_toy-Z_asym|<=0.2; s_hat(L10)=1.18 +1.60 -0.83 (LZ 1.0 +1.4 -0.7), max pull 0.37 sigma, prompt 66.8/66, delayed 53.0/55; ingredients L10: 2D->1D -0.6, bkg x2 -0.2, d-tail +0.16, toys +-0.2, nuisances 0.03, veto 0.00, 0.021 dex band -1.4 sigma; p0: S1c>500 2.4e-4 (3.5 sigma), 350-500 band core +3.8e-4; Fig.5 L10 curve 1.12 events split 0.21/0.59/0.21, event-bin fraction 0.070 vs 0.044; b(event cell)=1.2e-5, LR 265 per signal event; isoscalar inelastic O1 -0.53 sigma (not spectral: LZ Fig.1 spectrum gives the same), isovector +0.05
model_or_mechanism: binned (25 phd x 0.5 sigma cells ~ unbinned) extended Poisson likelihood in (S1c, d) for the science sample + Poisson totals for prompt/delayed samples coupled by lambda_PN, lambda_DN, lambda_MSSI, lambda_PG; Gaussian constraints from Table I; digitised Fig. 5 background and best-fit-L10 histograms; WimPyDD spectra mapped with NEST-LZ yields on the paper's contour energy scale; q0 with s>=0 profiled by iminuit; background-only toys (Baxter et al. Eq. 6) and a semi-analytic single-event p0 decomposition
stance: statistical reassessment (neutral: LZ's local significances reproduced within 0.2-0.4 sigma)
confidence: medium - digitised histograms and modelled within-panel S1c shapes; residual 0.3 sigma localised but unresolved
